items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I got acquainted with all the guys around - you know - at that point; I got to know George Zackin

ctx.x: Yes but then Bill got on the booze - so - and of course, Eddie was serious with those guys and there was a new ballroom down on Wilson Avenue - on the beach - they had built one and Eddie went in there and all of a sudden, the money started coming down. And, so, I decided I'd get the hell out of that band because it wasn't working enough, you know. And, I liked to play and, so, I got acquainted with all the guys around - you know - at that point; I got to know George Zackin---
Fine piano player - he lives in Tucson now - doesn't he?
